_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::reduced_airways#2. Half the Signal holds and half does not. On upstream red_airway_one_acinus_NeoHookean the terminal impedance is the MAT_0D_MAXWELL_ACINUS_* stiffness/viscosity, not a separate 'acinar condition'; dividing all four by 1e6 drops the inlet pressure from 521.378 to 5.2138e-04, i.e. onto the prescribed downstream pressure -- the 'no impedance' half, exact to six digits. The 'tidal volume diverges' half is FALSE: the acinar volume is 1.0236e+03 in both arms, agreeing to better than 1e-12 relative, because it is fixed by the prescribed inflow. 4C prints no acinus/compliance warning either way. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
